card: Refactors secondary indexes (txindex, blockfilterindex, coinstatsindex, txospenderindex) to interact with node state via interfaces rather than internal types like CBlockIndex, eliminating the requirement to hold cs_main during index synchronization and notification dispatch. Sync logic is extracted from BaseIndex into node::SyncChain and consolidated with standard notification handlers, which fixes a startup race condition under -reindex-chainstate and avoids returning stale spending data during reorgs. This decoupling enables running indexes in separate processes (#10102) and reusing sync logic for wallet rescans (#15719).
changed_since_previous: Rebased to adapt the recently merged txospenderindex to the decoupled interfaces, adjusted BlockInfo placement following #34079, and updated functional tests (such as feature_init.py) to accommodate sync threads only running when an index is behind.
evidence: Author commit 09601cbece notes fixing an easily reproducible startup race: 'indexes set m_synced = true too early, while there are still notifications from previously connected blocks in the validationinterface queue, causing those blocks to trigger the Rewind() call in the BaseIndex::BlockConnected notification handler, and pointlessly remove and then re-append the same blocks... easy to reproduce just by running the test/functional/feature_coinstatsindex.py "Test that the index works with -reindex-chainstate" test.'

Author commit 9171e838d9 cites performance improvements from locking changes: 'avoids holding cs_main while processing all indexing notifications. Previously cs_main was held while sending some notifications in the attachChain sync thread.'
problem: Secondary indexes access internal node structures directly and hold cs_main during indexing notifications and sync, creating lock contention and blocking out-of-process index execution. Furthermore, separate sync and notification paths previously led to race conditions during startup or -reindex-chainstate (triggering unnecessary rewinds) and left stale data queryable during block reorgs.

risk.why: Bugs in index synchronization or reorg rewind handling could cause indexes to corrupt, become permanently desynced, or serve incorrect data to RPC and BIP 157 P2P filter queries.

scope_notes: Large multi-commit refactoring across index code, interfaces, node logic, and unit/functional tests. Adapts all secondary indexes including the recently merged txospenderindex.
summary: Decouples secondary indexes (txindex, blockfilterindex, coinstatsindex, and txospenderindex) from node internals by removing references to node types like CBlockIndex, CChain, and CChainState. Extracts chain synchronization from BaseIndex into a shared node::SyncChain function and avoids holding cs_main during index sync and notification handling. Consolidates block appending and rewinding logic into unified notification callbacks and only spawns sync threads when indexing is actually needed.
